source.behavior: Open the selected site's content editor, render deterministic loading/not-found/error state, and read the requested WordPress content identity before any separate edit mutation is allowed.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The explicit tenant-owned route requires content.view, validates the adapted numeric site identity, post/page content type, and positive WordPress ID, resolves the site through the active tenant scope, binds that site into canonical_site_id, then renders the existing React ContentEditorRoute. The editor performs the real site-scoped read and renders loading, invalid-route, API failure/not-found, and authoritative synchronized content states.

authorization.guest_semantics: authentication middleware blocks the tenant-owned editor route before render
authorization.foreign_site_semantics: tenant-scoped Site lookup returns 404 before editor render
authorization.invalid_route_semantics: unsupported content type or non-positive/non-numeric WordPress identity returns 404 from the explicit canonical route handler

tenant_isolation.server_derived_ownership: TenantContext is established from the authenticated membership; both Site and ContentItem queries remain tenant scoped.
tenant_isolation.idor_proof: Focused acceptance proves an Alpha member cannot open Beta's site through either an Alpha route with Beta's site ID or a direct Beta tenant URL, and the read API also rejects the foreign site.

authoritative_read.response: ContentApiController::editor returns the current editor snapshot including remote hash/modified/version provenance used by the existing conflict-safe mutation path

rendering_semantics.loading: ContentEditorSaveControl renders Loading authoritative content… while the editor GET is pending.
rendering_semantics.invalid: Invalid route parameters produce the explicit Invalid content editor route state or server-side 404.
rendering_semantics.not_found_or_error: A missing or failed editor snapshot renders the API error/Content could not be loaded state rather than fabricated content.
rendering_semantics.success: Only the tenant/site/type/WordPress-ID matched editor snapshot is used to populate the editor draft.

mutation_boundary.save_operation: AIMW-BILL-42F7590F00 remains the separate PATCH content editor mutation.
mutation_boundary.approval_operation: AIMW-BILL-F5686193FE remains the separate POST approval mutation.

terminality.basis: The content editor source route is now an explicit Laravel tenant route bound to AIMW-CONT-2C02B7A328, permission guarded, tenant/site scoped, parameter validated, and connected to the existing real React editor and tenant-scoped authoritative editor read with deterministic failure states.
